title: Syllabus Overview
notes: Unit 9: Chemistry of Non-metals · Inorganic Chemistry · 22 teaching hours

• Hydrogen, Oxygen & Ozone: Atomic and nascent hydrogen, hydrogen isotopes & uses, hydrogen as fuel, heavy water
  • Hydrogen, Oxygen & Ozone: Allotropes of oxygen, types of oxides (acidic, basic, neutral, amphoteric, peroxide, mixed)
  • Hydrogen, Oxygen & Ozone: Applications of hydrogen peroxide
  • Hydrogen, Oxygen & Ozone: Medical and industrial application of oxygen
  • Hydrogen, Oxygen & Ozone: Ozone: Occurrence, preparation, structure, test, ozone layer depletion (causes, effects, control), uses
  • Nitrogen: Inertness of nitrogen and active nitrogen
  • Nitrogen: Chemical properties, applications, and harmful effects of ammonia
  • Nitrogen: Oxy-acids of nitrogen (name and formula)
  • Nitrogen: Chemical properties of nitric acid (acidic & oxidizing agent properties)
  • Nitrogen: Ring test for nitrate ion
  • Halogens: General characteristics of halogens
  • Halogens: Comparative study on preparation, chemical properties (with water, alkali, ammonia, oxidizing/bleaching action), and uses of Cl2, Br2, I2
  • Halogens: Tests for Cl2, Br2, and I2
  • Halogens: Comparative study on haloacids (HCl, HBr, HI): preparation, properties (reducing strength, acidic nature, solubility), and uses
  • Carbon: Allotropes of carbon including fullerenes (structure, properties, uses)
  • Carbon: Properties and uses of carbon monoxide
  • Phosphorus & Sulphur: Phosphorus: Allotropes (names), phosphine preparation, properties, and uses
  • Phosphorus & Sulphur: Sulphur: Allotropes (names) and uses
  • Phosphorus & Sulphur: Hydrogen sulphide: preparation (Kipp's apparatus), properties, and uses
  • Phosphorus & Sulphur: Sulphur dioxide: properties and uses
  • Phosphorus & Sulphur: Sulphuric acid: properties and uses
  • Phosphorus & Sulphur: Sodium thiosulphate: formula and uses
